info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Production Resource Generation API
info.description: The Production Resource Generation API enables users to initiate the process of generating production resources effectively and efficiently. This API is designed for developers who need to integrate resource creation into their workflows, facilitating seamless automated production setups. Key operations involve generating various production assets based on defined parameters, enabling quick scalability in production environments. Typically consumed by DevOps teams and application developers, this API supports use cases such as automated production deployments and resource management.
